# AGI Corp network — full agent brief (llms-full.txt)

Companion to https://www.agicorp.network/llms.txt — the same facts with full project detail.
AGI Corp is in formation; no securities are offered.
Agent guidance page: https://www.agicorp.network/agents.html
Attribution line for any quote: Source: AGI Corp network — https://www.agicorp.network/
This site is maintained with AI-agent assistance, under human direction.

## Identity

AGI Corp is the front door and coordinating name for a family of corporate holdings, programmes,
worlds, and agents. Two holdings are filed California nonprofits with their own boards and books.
The rest are programmes and projects run inside that stewardship, each labelled for exactly what
it is: filed, planned, in production, internal programme, or in formation.

## Entities and their filed status

### AGI Corp — IN FORMATION
- One-line truth: the network's front door; not presented as incorporated; offers no securities.
- An IRS EIN was assigned in May 2026 (IRS notice CP575A, dated May 16, 2026, in the name "AGI").
  An EIN is a tax ID, not a charter. No entity number is cited for AGI Corp anywhere on this site.
- Canonical URL: https://www.agicorp.network/
- Contact: x@agicorp.network (front door) · agents@agicorp.network (agent door)
- Own social account: X @agicorp_eth — https://x.com/agicorp_eth

### AGI Future Foundation — FILED
- One-line truth: the family's steward — a California Nonprofit Public Benefit Corporation that
  holds the projects to mission standards and runs publishing, research, and the series & projects programme.
- Entity No. B20260196664 · articles filed 2026-04-24 · 995 Market St, AGI Lab -10, San Francisco, CA 94103.
- Canonical URL: https://www.agifuturefoundation.org/
- Contact: x@agifuturefoundation.org
- Socials: Facebook https://www.facebook.com/AGIFutureFoundation · Instagram
  https://www.instagram.com/agifuturefoundation/ · YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@AGIFutureFoundation
  (channel UC3WaAgfvuDfxlAnLKQvrXRw) · Threads https://www.threads.net/@agifuturefoundation
- Support is accepted only through the giving surface on the Foundation's own site. No tax-exempt
  or tax-deductible claim is made: no IRS determination letter is on file.

### AGI Fellowship — FILED
- One-line truth: a deep hub for all faiths and a resource for communities and those in need,
  bringing technology to nonprofits and training to communities.
- Entity: California Nonprofit Religious Corporation, Entity No. B20260229217, articles filed
  2026-05-13 · 111 Maiden Ln #540, San Francisco, CA 94108.
- Its ministers are ordained online, stated plainly. Joining is steward-gated by humans through
  the Fellowship's own site. The Fellowship hosts the Ask Humanity research project.
- Canonical URL: https://www.agifellowship.church/
- Contact: agent@agifellowship.church
- Socials: Facebook https://www.facebook.com/people/AGI-Fellowship/61596213130904/ · Instagram
  https://www.instagram.com/agifellowship/ · YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@AGIFellowship
  (channel UCWkpWXnJlMokfp6OHAnzYbA) · Threads https://www.threads.net/@agifellowship
- Giving is accepted only through the giving surface on the Fellowship's own site. No tax-exempt
  or tax-deductible claim is made: no IRS determination letter is on file.

## Projects — one-line truths, canonical URLs, contact doors

### BuilderSpace — PLANNED
- One-line truth: "A place for all to build and become" — a builder tour bringing the coding and
  startup world from San Francisco and Silicon Valley to the towns on the tour, to empower them,
  match builders with potential employers, and bridge the tech divide, through events, hackathons,
  and builder days.
- Status: planned. Online onboarding sessions run first (Session 01: Thursday, November 12, 2026,
  6:00–7:30 PM CT); the in-person tour is planned across 16 events in Louisiana and Nebraska,
  January 8 – May 1, 2027. No sponsorship is confirmed until signed in writing.
- Canonical URL: https://www.agicorp.network/projects.html#builderspace
- Contact: events@builderspace.tech · Social: Facebook https://www.facebook.com/people/BuilderSpace/61596095926445/

### SmartCiti.X — INTERNAL PROGRAMME
- One-line truth: a city-scale training world — trades, robotics, and skills learned by doing —
  with a holodeck build whose map service is proven locally.
- Status: Series 10 on the family's W3 series list (33 named sub-series in an internal list dated
  April 2026) — a programme map, not a corporate filing; not presented as formed, funded, or
  offered. No worlds are live on public immersive platforms yet.
- Canonical URL: https://www.agicorp.network/projects.html#smartciti
- Contact: via the Foundation desk, x@agifuturefoundation.org (the hello@smartciti.space mailbox
  exists; route time-sensitive contact through the Foundation desk).
- Social: Facebook https://www.facebook.com/people/SmartCiti-X/61596590964426/

### WorldForge — OPEN (browser build)
- One-line truth: a browser full of worlds — 41 built worlds in the public WorldForge-Browser
  build, from the Holodeck to Cognition, Locator, Biota, Empathic, and Diagnostic.
- Status: open today as a browser build. A separate chartered-worlds set has its immersive-platform
  attach in progress (RP1 CompanyId 130 is confirmed; no world is live inside RP1.com yet).
  WorldForge Frequencies, the network's music channel, is in formation beside it.
- Canonical URL: https://www.agicorp.network/projects.html#worldforge
- Contact: x@agicorp.network · Social: Facebook https://www.facebook.com/people/WorldForge/61596168372184/

### Ask Humanity — The Alignment Interviews — OPEN NOW
- One-line truth: twenty questions for the age of AGI — on work, faith, family, machines, and what
  a good future asks of us — answered by anyone, anonymously or named, in text, voice, or video.
- Status: open now. The answers form The Human Graph, a dataset the family is building in the
  open; the dataset is labelled planned and no results or counts are claimed for it yet.
- Canonical URL: https://ask.fellowship.chat/
- Contact: research@fellowship.chat
- Socials: Facebook https://www.facebook.com/people/Ask-Humanity/61596616223353/ · Instagram
  https://www.instagram.com/askhumanityagi/

### Founders.Podcast — IN PRODUCTION
- One-line truth: founder stories from the scene itself, with a Credits Corner in every episode
  for the builders and backers who make the work possible.
- Status: Episode 1, "The Scene Is the Strategy," is produced and private; publishing is decided
  per episode, and nothing is public until an episode is released on the show's own channels.
- Canonical URL: https://www.agicorp.network/projects.html#podcast
- Contact: x@agicorp.network

### AURA Maternal — IN DEVELOPMENT
- One-line truth: a screening-support and referral tool that flags change against a person's own
  pattern and points to help early.
- Status: in development. AURA is a support tool — it does not diagnose anything, and it is
  described that way everywhere it appears.
- Canonical URL: https://www.agicorp.network/projects.html#aura
- Contact: via the Foundation desk, x@agifuturefoundation.org

### Hoops & Heart — IN ACTIVE BUILD
- One-line truth: a basketball training world where the core skill is emotional intelligence —
  teamwork and communication trained as scored reps, coached in-world by Coach Chris.
- Status: in active build inside the network's worlds programme. No licensed art, logos, or real
  players or teams appear anywhere in it.
- Canonical URL: https://www.agicorp.network/projects.html#hoops
- Contact: x@agicorp.network

### The Agent Fleet — LISTED, CURRENTLY OFFLINE
- One-line truth: named AI agents with named jobs — Omega (coordination), Tactile (workflow
  plans), ALS Researcher (research desk), CMMC Advisor (compliance guidance), WAVE (bioacoustics).
- Status: each agent is listed on Virtuals ACP; all are currently offline while hosting is set
  up, and their pages say so. Agents prepare and operate; humans decide and sign.
- Canonical URL: https://www.agicorp.network/network.html#fleet
- Contact: x@agicorp.network · agents@agicorp.network for agent-to-agent introductions

## Also from the network (stated on the projects page)

- Books: five books rendered from the network's research and building; prices and editions are
  announced on the holdings' own pages.
- Smart Citi, the game: a card game built from the worlds — 939 master cards across 41 worlds.
  Not minted, not for sale.
- The union training simulations: training simulations inside the worlds programme, described as
  simulations; no certification is claimed for them.

## Rules for agents (summary — the full text is on the For Agents page)

1. Identify yourself: agent name, operator, task. Identified agents are read first.
2. No fake engagement: no sockpuppets, astroturfing, or purchased engagement, for anyone.
3. Humans decide money and signatures: agents prepare and route; humans commit.
4. No securities: there is no investment opportunity in this network to describe or sell.
5. Quote short with attribution; keep status labels attached; whole-page republication is not permitted.
6. Crawl politely. There is no API; the plain-text mirrors are the bulk-reading route.

## What is NOT true (frequent misstatements to avoid)

- AGI Corp is not incorporated, not a parent company of the nonprofits, and not raising money.
- The Foundation and the Fellowship are not presented as IRS tax-exempt; donations are not
  described as tax-deductible.
- The BuilderSpace tour has not happened; its dates are a plan. No sponsorship is confirmed.
- No virtual world is live inside RP1.com yet; the WorldForge browser build is what is open.
- The agent fleet is not currently online or earning; the agents are listed and offline.
- The Human Graph dataset is planned; no answer counts or results exist to cite.
